provenance.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 (1950-2000) plus provisional pre-1950 schedules
provenance.notes: ASFR and sex-specific mortality annually for 1950-2000 are derived from WPP 2024 world files. 1900 and 1949 mortality are the earlier provisional world schedule duplicated by sex. 1900 and 1949 ASFR use the WPP 1950 schedule scaled by 1.05 and 1.00 respectively; they are provisional, not historical age-specific estimates. Sex ratio at birth is a provisional 1.05 male/female ratio; it is not yet sourced to an annual WPP SRB series. The 1900 and 1949 provisional mortality schedules were multiplied by 1.45 (capped at 1,000 per 1,000) to align the pre-1950 total trajectory with the source-backed OWID/WPP 1950 total; this is a total-population calibration of provisional rates, not a historical mortality observation. Annual WPP 2024 ASFR and derived sex-specific mortality are used for every year 1950-2000 instead of interpolating only three benchmark years.
